news.headline: uniQure Reports Q2 2026 Results and Confirms FDA Alignment on Accelerated Approval Path for AMT-130
news.summary: uniQure posted Q2 revenue of $5.84M (beating consensus) and said official FDA meeting minutes confirmed that three-year AMT-130 data can support a BLA under the accelerated approval pathway, with submission still planned for Q3 2026. Cash of $810.3M following a $259M offering is expected to fund operations into 2030, and topline four-year AMT-130 data are due in September 2026.

news.headline: Wells Fargo Raises uniQure Price Target to $75, Keeps Overweight
news.summary: Wells Fargo lifted its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60 and reiterated an Overweight rating, citing the improved regulatory outlook for AMT-130 and the strengthened balance sheet after the $259M offering.

news.headline: Wolfe Research Upgrades uniQure to Outperform, Sees 'Clear Path to Approval' for AMT-130
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded QURE to Outperform from Peer Perform with a $65 price target, arguing the market underestimates the odds of success and modeling roughly 70% probability of approval with about $2B in U.S. peak sales potential for AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure Receives $65 Consensus Price Target from Brokerages
news.summary: Wall Street's coverage of uniQure remained firmly bullish in mid-August, with a consensus 'Strong Buy' rating (11 buys, 0 sells) and an average price target near $65-$70, reflecting continued confidence in the AMT-130 regulatory and commercial trajectory.

news.headline: Wall Street Zen Upgrades uniQure to 'Hold' After Brief Sell Call
news.summary: Automated research service Wall Street Zen raised uniQure back to Hold after briefly flagging it Sell in early August, an outlier stance versus the broadly bullish sell-side consensus following the FDA alignment news.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline four-year safety/efficacy data from the Phase I/II study (12 high-dose and 12 low-dose patients, plus 3 additional high-dose patients at 3 years) benchmarked against a natural history cohort; data cut as of June 30, 2026.

catalysts.label: U.S. BLA submission for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of AMT-130 for Huntington's disease, based on three-year data with an accompanying four-year update, and to request priority review.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorisation Application for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: Parallel filing planned in the UK following a positive MHRA pre-submission meeting, alongside the U.S. BLA.

catalysts.label: FDA acceptance / priority review decision on AMT-130 BLA
catalysts.detail: Following BLA submission, FDA filing acceptance and any priority review designation would set the accelerated-approval review clock; exact timing depends on submission completeness and outstanding alignment on the confirmatory trial's control arm design.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 high-dose cohort data (epilepsy)
catalysts.detail: Second, higher-dose cohort of the Phase I/IIa GenTLE trial of AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy; enrollment targeted for completion in mid-2026 with follow-up data to come later.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and corporate update
catalysts.detail: Next scheduled quarterly results, expected to confirm BLA/MAA submission status and provide further detail on the September four-year AMT-130 dataset.

pulse: uniQure enters late Q3 2026 on a strong regulatory and market upswing: the FDA has confirmed that three-year AMT-130 data can anchor an accelerated-approval BLA, and the stock's rally has been reinforced by a $259M raise (cash of $810M, runway into 2030) and a string of price-target hikes from Wells Fargo, Wolfe Research and others, pushing consensus toward $65-$70 with a Strong Buy rating. Real de-risking is still pending, however, hinging on the topline four-year AMT-130 data due in September 2026, the actual Q3 BLA/UK MAA filings, and final FDA alignment on the confirmatory trial's control design. The September data readout and formal BLA submission are the next major share-price catalysts to watch.
